answered.sql: SELECT Director.name FROM Director JOIN Movie ON Director.id = Movie.director_id WHERE Movie.release_date = (SELECT MAX(release_date) FROM Movie)

candidates.meaning: Find the director of the latest movie.
candidates.sql: SELECT Director.name FROM Director JOIN Movie ON Director.id = Movie.director_id ORDER BY Movie.release_date DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Find the director of the most recent movie.
candidates.sql: SELECT director_id FROM Movie ORDER BY release_date DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Identify the actor who played the latest movie's lead role.
